description: The courier (W2 PHONE-STUDIO). The six Kaggle verbs in src/kaggle.rs, reachable from the shell as window.TTSTVHost.kaggle, and the two key-store commands. The page pastes a kaggle.json ONCE into kaggle_key_set; no command ever answers with the key, and every courier command reads it from the 0600 file in app_data_dir() itself. `fetch` is the one that carries bytes: output() answers only names and signed storage URLs, and a frank:// page has no CORS route to a storage host.
